```{r load data, warning=F, message=F}

refit_models_flag <- FALSE

source(here::here("0-config.R"))

df_all <- readRDS(here("data","mortality_analysis_dataset.rds")) %>%
  dplyr::filter(adaptive_rand == "Randomization 1")

# Project coordinates to UTM so distances are in meters, not degrees

df_proj <- df_all %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  st_as_sf(coords = c("lon", "lat"), crs = 4326) %>%
  st_transform(crs = 32631) %>% # UTM zone 31N, for Niger
  mutate(lon = sf::st_coordinates(.)[,1],
         lat = sf::st_coordinates(.)[,2])

niger_adm1 <- st_read(dsn = paste0(shp_data,"ner_adm01_feb2018/NER_adm01_feb2018.shp"))

```

```{r functions}

plot_matern_corr_proj <- function(spamm_model_fit, filenameval = "avenir-materncorr") {
  # create a distance matrix between all points
  coords <- as.matrix(spamm_model_fit$data[, c("lon", "lat")])
  d_vec_m <- as.numeric(dist(coords))
  
  # get estimated parameters from the Matern function
  est_nu <- spamm_model_fit$CorrEst_and_RanFix$corrPars$`1`$nu
  est_rho <- spamm_model_fit$CorrEst_and_RanFix$corrPars$`1`$rho
  
  rho_sci <- format(est_rho, scientific = TRUE, digits = 3)
  range_km <- 1 / (1000 * est_rho)
  
  # estimate the correlation between each location
  matern_vec <- spaMM::MaternCorr(d = d_vec_m, nu = est_nu, rho = est_rho)
  
  # store in a data frame for plotting
  d_matern_cor <- tibble(distm = d_vec_m,
                         distkm = distm / 1000,
                         materncor = matern_vec) %>%
    mutate(bin_km = cut(
      distkm,
      breaks = seq(0, max(distkm), by = 0.025),
      include.lowest = TRUE
    )) %>%
    group_by(bin_km) %>%
    summarise(
      distkm    = mean(distkm),
      materncor = mean(materncor),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    arrange(distkm)
  
  label_text <- sprintf("nu = %0.3f\rho = %0.3f\nrange = %0.2f km",
                        est_nu,
                        est_rho,
                        range_km)
  
  # plot the correlation function
  plot_materncor <- ggplot(data = d_matern_cor %>% filter(distkm <= 50)) +
    # geom_point(aes(x=distms,y=distkm)) +
    geom_point(
      aes(x = distkm, y = materncor),
      color = "black",
      alpha = 1,
      size = 0.1
    ) +
    # geom_vline(xintercept= 3 ,color="gray60", lwd=0.1) +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.2)) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(0, seq(10, 50, by = 10))) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 50), ylim = c(0, 1)) +
    labs(x = "distance (km)", y = "Matern correlation") +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = 15,
      y = 0.90,
      label = as.expression(bquote(nu == .(
        format(est_nu, digits = 3)
      ))),
      hjust = 0,
      size = 6
    ) +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = 15,
      y = 0.80,
      label = as.expression(bquote(rho == .(rho_sci) ~ m^{-1})),
      hjust = 0,
      size = 6
    ) +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = 15,
      y = 0.65,
      label = as.expression(bquote(range == .(
        format(range_km, digits = 4)
      ) ~ km)),
      hjust = 0,
      size = 6
    ) +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(
      panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank(),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 16),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 18)
    )
  
  ggsave(
    filename = paste0(figure_path, filenameval, ".png"),
    plot = plot_materncor,
    device = "png",
    width = 3.3,
    height = 3.5
  )
  
  return(plot_materncor)
  
}

get_grid_preds <- function(input_grid, 
                           spamm_model_fit, 
                           tx_group = "Treatment"){
  
  # convert grid into a data.frame with lon/lat variables
  newd <- input_grid %>%
    st_centroid() %>% 
    st_as_sf(crs = 32631) %>% 
    mutate(lon = sf::st_coordinates(.)[,1],
           lat = sf::st_coordinates(.)[,2],
           isTreated_child = tx_group,
           site_code = 0, #dummy
           pt_year_1to59 = 1000) %>% #per 1000 person-years
    st_drop_geometry()
  
  # get predictions (response)
  
  temp_preds <- predict(object = spamm_model_fit,
                        type = "response",
                        newdata = newd)
  
  # get estimated variance at each location
  temp_predVar <- spaMM::get_predVar(object = spamm_model_fit, 
                                     newdata = newd, 
                                     which = "predVar")
  
  # create a dataframe 
  # for predictions using 
  # centroid coordinates from the grid
  # add predictions and variance to the grid
  ret <- input_grid %>% 
    as.data.frame() %>% 
    st_as_sf(crs = 32631) %>% 
    mutate(pred = as.numeric(temp_preds),
           pred_var = as.numeric(temp_predVar),
           isTreated_child = tx_group)
  
  return(ret)
  
}



```

## Simple Kriging model

### Fit model
```{r fit simple kriging model}
# fit spatial models for mortality rate with new binary tx vars,
# isTreated_child: 0=placebo+infant, 1=child
# isTreated_alltx: 0=placebo, 1=infant+child

if(refit_models_flag) {
  avail_thr <- parallel::detectCores(logical = FALSE) - 1L
  
  tic("Simple Krig: fit spaMM model for child mortality")
  fitmort_child_simp_krig <- spaMM::fitme(
    n_deaths_1to59 ~
      1 +
      Matern(1 | lat + lon) +
      isTreated_child +
      # (1|site_code) +
      offset(log(pt_year_1to59)),
    data = df_proj,
    family = poisson(link = "log"),
    control.HLfit = list(NbThreads = avail_thr)
  )
  toc()
  
  saveRDS(fitmort_child_simp_krig,
          here("data", "fitmort_child_simp_krig.rds"))
} else {
  fitmort_child_simp_krig <- readRDS(here("data", "fitmort_child_simp_krig.rds"))
}

```

### Summary
```{r simple krig summary}

summary(fitmort_child_simp_krig)

print(AIC(fitmort_child_simp_krig))

```

## Generalized kriging model

### Fit model
```{r fit gen kriging model}

if(refit_models_flag) {
  tic("Generalized Krig: fit spaMM model for child mortality with linear lat/lon terms")
  fitmort_child_gen_krig <- spaMM::fitme(
    n_deaths_1to59 ~
      1 +
      lat + lon +
      Matern(1 | lat + lon) +
      isTreated_child +
      # (1|site_code) +
      offset(log(pt_year_1to59)),
    data = df_proj,
    family = poisson(link = "log"),
    control.HLfit = list(NbThreads = avail_thr)
  )
  toc()
  
  saveRDS(fitmort_child_gen_krig,
          here("data", "fitmort_child_gen_krig.rds"))
} else{
  fitmort_child_gen_krig <- readRDS(here("data", "fitmort_child_gen_krig.rds"))
}

```

### Compare to simple model

```{r compare simple and general kriging models}

print(AIC(fitmort_child_simp_krig))
print(AIC(fitmort_child_gen_krig))

LRT(fitmort_child_gen_krig, fitmort_child_simp_krig)

```

LRT and AIC indicate that adding linear terms for latitude and longitude significantly improves model fit, i.e., the generalized krige model is preferred over the simple krige. 

### Model results

```{r model results for general kriging}

summary(fitmort_child_gen_krig)

materncorr_gen_krig <- plot_matern_corr_proj(fitmort_child_gen_krig,
                                             "avenir-materncorr-fitmort_child_gen_krig")

materncorr_gen_krig

```


## Generalized krig with interaction

### Fit model
```{r fit interaction model}

if(refit_models_flag) {
  tic("fit spaMM model for child mortality with interaction")
  fitmort_child_gen_krig_int <- spaMM::fitme(
    n_deaths_1to59 ~
      1 + lat + lon +
      Matern(1 | lat + lon) +
      isTreated_child +
      isTreated_child * lat + isTreated_child *
      lon +
      # (1|site_code) +
      offset(log(pt_year_1to59)),
    data = df_proj,
    family = poisson(link = "log"),
    control.HLfit = list(NbThreads = avail_thr)
  )
  toc()
  
  saveRDS(fitmort_child_gen_krig_int,
          here("data", "fitmort_child_gen_krig_int.rds"))
} else {
  fitmort_child_gen_krig_int <- readRDS(here("data", "fitmort_child_gen_krig_int.rds"))
}

```

### Compare to generalized krig model

```{r compare interaction model}

print(AIC(fitmort_child_gen_krig))
print(AIC(fitmort_child_gen_krig_int))

LRT(fitmort_child_gen_krig_int, fitmort_child_gen_krig)

```

LRT and AIC indicate that the model with the interaction between treatment label and latitude and longitude fits better than the one without interaction. 

### Model results

```{r results of the interaction model}

summary(fitmort_child_gen_krig_int)

materncorr_gen_krig_int <- plot_matern_corr_proj(fitmort_child_gen_krig_int,
                                                 "avenir-materncorr-fitmort_child_gen_krig")

materncorr_gen_krig_int

```

### Model predictions

```{r predictions from interaction model}

b_boxgrid <- st_make_grid(niger_adm1, n = c(100, 100), what = "centers", crs = 32631)

b_preds_mort_tx0 <- get_grid_preds(input_grid = b_boxgrid,
                                         spamm_model_fit = fitmort_child_gen_krig_int,
                                         tx_group = "Control")

b_preds_mort_tx1 <- get_grid_preds(input_grid = b_boxgrid,
                                         spamm_model_fit = fitmort_child_gen_krig_int,
                                         tx_group = "Treatment")

b_preds_long <- rbind(
  b_preds_mort_tx0,
  b_preds_mort_tx1
)

saveRDS(b_preds_long, here("data", "b_preds_long.rds"))
```

### ATE estimation

```{r ate estimate}

b_preds_wide <- b_preds_long %>%
  dplyr::select(-pred_var) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = isTreated_child, values_from = pred, names_prefix = "pred") %>%
  mutate(ATE = predTreatment - predControl)

saveRDS(b_preds_wide, here("data", "ate_preds.rds"))

```
